verdict.rationale: Belvo documents retrieving transaction history via its API and paginated List endpoints (100 per page by default, up to 1000 via `page_size`, filterable by `link`). Recurrent links refresh weekly and notify via webhook, which is a partial sync pattern, but nothing shows fetching only changed transactions. missing for 10: documented transaction history depth, an explicit incremental/delta sync mechanism for fetching only changed records, transaction-specific endpoint docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull transaction history for a connected account through the API — paginated, with documented history depth and a sync pattern for fetching only what changed

citations.quote: Retrieve transaction history, account balances, and investment details seamlessly.
by default you will receive 100 results per page. However, you can increase this to a maximum of 1000 results using the `page_size` query parameter
We strongly recommend that you use the `link` query parameter in your List requests so that you only receive results for a given `link.id`.
With recurrent links, Belvo automatically refreshes information weekly and notifies you via webhook so you always have up-to-date data.
